objective: Understand selection and preservation of distinguishing visual features and attachment relationships during image-to-3D reconstruction.
interpretive_constraints: Model-reported uncertainty does not establish ambiguity or insufficient grounding in the source.
Preserve distinguishing features and relationships; broad resemblance alone does not establish fidelity.
The generator and critic may share omissions; model agreement is not independent validation.
Treat infrastructure failures separately from quality; retain every attempt.
No claim about proprietary internal architecture or model-wide failure rate is supported.
Depicted attachment, physical clearance and fidelity to distinguishing features are separate axes; do not retroactively change prior scores or equate model judgement with independent validation.
next_action: Design and commit a matched image-reconstruction comparison adding a functional-geometry requirement alone, without supplying the plug placement. Score attachment and receiving voids separately with retained renders and independent mesh checks. Do not repeat completed cohorts.
programme_status: ongoing; all registered cohorts are complete and no model processes remain active
